answer: A concrete wall against sybils is making duplication expensive by construction. Each new identity completes a warmup of genuine inference whose outputs other nodes verify, so mass-registered wallets burn real compute before any reward exists. Scoring then weighs history: honest streaks accumulate like a rising nadir, while proven copycats fall to a opal where payouts approach zero. Committees that check answers form an ocean of review, rotated at random so no ring of fake peers can capture them and attest each other.
